Verified: the cited passage was read in a published translation, or the locus is confirmed by a peer-reviewed study.
Supported: confirmed by a published secondary source; the primary line is not yet read.
Qualified: the passage was read, but the claim needs care, as the note explains.
Pending: awaiting a print edition. Hidden by default and withheld from publication.
Direct · Onomastic · Thematic: the text names the figure · the name appears only in a place or personal name · a comparison of motif, no name.
Comparative plate: an authentic object of the right culture and type whose identification is uncertain. It is never presented as a portrait.

Plates: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (Open Access, CC0), the Cleveland Museum of Art (Open Access, CC0) and the Princeton University Art Museum (public domain; images courtesy of the Princeton University Art Museum).
